title: num_slots upper bound: spec dropped 8-32; parsers may want pinning (design choice)
description: From b7z9.156 security review (finding S3). The withdrawn 02a-tdma.md text said 'N_slots (u8): default 8-32'; the b7z9.156 fix documents what all three stacks implement (nonzero u8, default 8 — Rust tdma_beacon.rs NumSlotsZero, Python 'num_slots must be nonzero', C beacon.c num_slots==0U reject; no upper bound anywhere) and adds the nonzero MUST to the normative table at 02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.2. The bead offered both options ('pin the 8-32 range in all parsers OR make the spec say nonzero-u8') and the spec-follows-implementations option was taken. If Mark prefers the parser-pinning option: bound num_slots to 8-32 (or another max) in rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs parse/validate, python/src/lichen/rpl/tdma_beacon.py, lichen/subsys/lichen/link/beacon.c, plus vectors. Note: 255 slots x 2346ms minimum slot = ~10min superframe, so very large values are unusable in practice but not injectable (Schnorr48-signed beacons).
